message.content:
Here’s a curated list of horror movies that will keep you on the edge of your seat this Friday night. I’ve grouped them by vibe so you can pick the mood you’re after—classic chills, psychological dread, supernatural scares, or modern gore‑fest.

---

## 1. Classic & Timeless

| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **The Shining** | 1980 | A masterclass in atmosphere and dread. |
| **Halloween** | 1978 | The original slasher that set the standard. |
| **The Exorcist** | 1973 | A terrifying blend of faith and horror. |
| **Psycho** | 1960 | Hitchcock’s psychological thriller that still terrifies. |

> *Tip:* If you’re a fan of slow‑burn tension, start with **The Shining**. It’s a marathon of creeping dread.

---

## 2. Psychological & Mind‑Bending

| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **Hereditary** | 2018 | A family drama that turns into a nightmare. |
| **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror that’s as unsettling as it is beautiful. |
| **The Babadook** | 2014 | A psychological thriller about grief and monsters. |
| **Get Out** | 2017 | A sharp social commentary wrapped in horror. |

> *Tip:* For a mind‑twisting experience, pair **Hereditary** with a dark, quiet night.

---

## 3. Supernatural & Paranormal

| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A chilling true‑story‑based supernatural thriller. |
| **Insidious** | 2010 | A family’s fight against a dark realm. |
| **Poltergeist** | 1982 | Classic haunted house with a modern twist. |
| **Sinister** | 2012 | A true crime documentary turns into a horror nightmare. |

> *Tip:* If you love jump‑scares and ghostly vibes, **The Conjuring** is a solid pick.

---

## 4. Modern Gore & Slasher

| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **It Follows** | 2014 | A unique take on the “invisible stalker” trope. |
| **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence is deadly—watch the tension build. |
| **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑slasher that subverts expectations. |
| **The Purge** | 2013 | A dystopian horror that’s both social commentary and gore. |

> *Tip:* For a high‑octane, blood‑curdling night, go with **It Follows** or **A Quiet Place**.

---

## 5. Cult & Indie Gems

| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **The Witch** | 2015 | A slow‑burn, atmospheric horror set in 1630s New England. |
| **Mandy** | 2018 | A psychedelic revenge story with stunning visuals. |
| **The Lighthouse** | 2019 | Two lighthouse keepers descend into madness. |
| **The Others** | 2001 | A haunting tale of family secrets and the supernatural. |

> *Tip:* If you want something a bit different, **The Witch** offers a unique, unsettling experience.

---

## 6. Family‑Friendly (for the less intense crowd)

| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **Coraline** | 2009 | A stop‑motion adventure with creepy twists. |
| **ParaNorman** | 2012 | A kid‑friendly horror with heart. |
| **The Nightmare Before Christmas** | 1993 | A spooky musical that’s more fun than fright. |

> *Tip:* Great for a lighter horror night or if you’re watching with younger viewers.

---

### Quick Picks for a Friday Night

| Mood | Movie | Why It Fits |
|------|-------|-------------|
| **Classic dread** | *The Shining* | Slow‑burn, atmospheric terror. |
| **Psychological twist** | *Hereditary* | Family drama meets supernatural horror. |
| **Supernatural chills** | *The Conjuring* | True‑story‑based ghost horror. |
| **Gore & suspense** | *It Follows* | Unique concept, high tension. |
| **Cult classic** | *The Witch* | Slow‑burn, period horror. |

---

#### Final Thought

Pick one that matches your mood, grab some popcorn (or a bowl of hot chocolate for extra comfort), and enjoy a night of chills! If you need more details on any film or want a specific recommendation based on your favorite sub‑genre, just let me know. Happy watching!
